build:docker.description: Build the tuiteraz/bensyne Docker image. The tag is extracted at run time from apps/bensyne-mcp/pyproject.toml (version = "x.y.z") via an inline node -e read.

options.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=fs.readFileSync('pyproject.toml','utf8').match(/^version\s*=\s*\"(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\"/m);if(!m){console.error('no version in pyproject.toml');process.exit(1)};console.log(m[1])" > /tmp/bensyne-version.txt && VERSION=$(cat /tmp/bensyne-version.txt) && docker build -t tuiteraz/bensyne:${VERSION} .

start:docker.description: Run the tuiteraz/bensyne image (tag from pyproject.toml) with port 18300 mapped to container 3000 and a temp data dir mounted at /data/mnemosyne/data. Exact invocation: docker run -d --name bensyne-smoke -p 18300:3000 -v <tmpdir>:/data/mnemosyne/data tuiteraz/bensyne:<version>. Cleanup: docker rm -f bensyne-smoke.

options.command: VERSION=$(node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=fs.readFileSync('pyproject.toml','utf8').match(/^version\s*=\s*\"(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\"/m);if(!m){console.error('no version in pyproject.toml');process.exit(1)};console.log(m[1])") && TMPDIR_DATA=$(mktemp -d /tmp/bensyne-data-XXXXXX) && docker rm -f bensyne-smoke 2>/dev/null; docker run -d --name bensyne-smoke -p 18300:3000 -v ${TMPDIR_DATA}:/data/mnemosyne/data tuiteraz/bensyne:${VERSION}

bump-version.description: Bump the app version per Conventional Commits by scanning commit subjects since the last commit touching apps/bensyne-mcp/pyproject.toml (BREAKING CHANGE or type! -> major, feat -> minor, else patch). Shared script: scripts/bump-version.mjs. CLI: node scripts/bump-version.mjs --app <appRoot> [--version-file <file>] [--dry-run]. Pass --dry-run via nx to report old->new without writing.
